# rviuer

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle:experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![CRAN-status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/rviuer)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rviuer)

The goal of rviuer is to provide a tool to show the plot in R session (and to practice my Rust coding skills 🦀). 

## Installation

You can install the development version of rviuer from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Exceret/rviuer")
```

## Exmaple

You can use `capture_plot` to capture the plot (In theory, any format works, including `ggplot2`) in R session.

```{r}
#| label = "example_capture",
#| eval = FALSE
library(rviuer)
draw_pixels("rviuer") |>
  capture_plot(width = 50, height = 20) |>
  render_plot()
```

You can also use file path directly.

```{r}
#| label = "example_file_path",
#| eval = FALSE
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tidyverse/dplyr/main/man/figures/logo.png"
tmp <- tempdir()
dest <- file.path(tmp, "logo.png")

download.file(url, destfile = dest, mode = "wb")
render_plot(dest)
```
